description: SLICERBAR: Simply Better Power BI Reports Empower your Power BI reports with state-of-the-art filter navigation. SLICERBAR unifies Slicers, Date Pickers, Hierarchies, Groups, and Buttons into a single, intuitive navigation bar, so your team spends less time managing filters and more time making decisions. Why SLICERBAR? All-in-one design - Slicers, Date Pickers, Hierarchies, Groups, and Buttons combined in a single visual Automatic alignment - Items arrange themselves for a clean, consistent layout without one-by-one management Modern, no-code UI - Design and configure powerful filter experiences without expert know-how Flexible theming - Apply consistent themes across reports while fine-tuning individual items when needed Better navigation - Guide users through complex data and make self-service reporting easier Main Features Hierarchies Drill down and roll back up through multiple hierarchy levels Set default selections manually or automatically by rule Show measures as values, data bars, or target indicators Conditional formatting and visibility Date Pickers Absolute and relative date selections Calendar tiles, slider controls, and quick presets such as "last 7 days" Step forward or back by month, quarter, or year without losing other filters Show key measures directly on the calendar Conditional default selections Conditional formatting and visibility Slicers Single and…
